mcat_description.short: MS Security Cabins are prefabricated mild steel portable structures designed to house security guards at entry points, gates, and perimeter checkposts. Sold as complete ready-to-install units, they are fabricated from MS angle iron frames with corrugated or plain MS sheet cladding, and are customisable in size and finish.
mcat_description.long: MS Security Cabins are factory-built, portable guard enclosures constructed from mild steel structural frames with MS corrugated sheet or colour-coated sheet exteriors, pre-laminated MDF or laminated plywood interiors, and thermocole or glass wool insulation. Standard configurations include aluminium sliding windows with safety grills, a single MS door with locking arrangement, vinyl or bison panel flooring, and pre-wired electrical fittings. Common footprints range from 4×4 ft (single guard) to 10×6 ft (double guard), with a standard height of 8.6 ft, and units are equipped with lifting hooks for crane or truck relocation. They are widely deployed as security booths, toll booths, parking lot cabins, society gate cabins, and site entry checkposts across industrial, residential, and commercial premises in India.

unit_quoting_context.unit_reasoning: MS Security Cabins are complete, self-contained prefabricated units sold as individual structures; all Indian manufacturer sites and B2B listings consistently quote per Piece or per Unit, reflecting the discrete, project-based nature of the purchase.

sub_segment_units.note: Some FRP or larger custom-built cabins are quoted per sq ft of floor area, but this is a minority quoting convention.

market_context: MS Security Cabins in India are a well-established segment of the prefabricated portable cabin market, dominated by small and medium fabricators concentrated in NCR (Greater Noida, Faridabad, Delhi), Maharashtra (Thane, Pune, Mumbai), Telangana (Hyderabad), Odisha (Bhubaneswar), Andhra Pradesh (Guntur), and Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Vadodara). The product is universally sold as a complete, ready-to-install unit per piece, with standard sizes of 4×4 ft, 5×5 ft, 6×4 ft, 6×6 ft, and 10×6 ft at a standard height of 8.6 ft. Construction typically uses MS angle iron or square pipe structural frames, MS corrugated sheet or colour-coated sheet exterior cladding, pre-laminated MDF or laminated plywood interior panelling, thermocole or glass wool insulation, aluminium sliding windows with safety grills, vinyl or bison panel flooring, and Havells or equivalent branded electrical fittings. Material variants include pure MS, GI (galvanised iron), ACP (aluminium composite panel) cladded, and FRP — with MS being the dominant commercial form. Painting specifications commonly include red oxide primer with synthetic enamel or epoxy topcoat; some premium units use Asian Paints Rust Shield for UV and corrosion protection. Buyers are primarily industrial facility managers, real estate developers, construction contractors, and institutional procurement teams. The category sits within the broader Prefabricated Structures taxonomy alongside portable offices, bunk houses, and portable toilets — the key differentiator being the security/guard function and compact footprint. No BIS/IS standard specific to MS security cabins was found; quality is typically governed by fabricator standards and buyer specifications (single source — low confidence for standards claim).
